Commentary.Commentary: Update 1919 IST - Unfortunately folks, it has started to rain and the start of the chase has been delayed. Stay tuned for latest updates...

The English attack was impressive once again and they bowled with intelligence and wit. Mark Wood and Chris Woakes were highly efficient with the ball and put brakes on the Pakistani batsmen. Imad Wasim played a gritty knock of 63 runs lower down the order and was instrumental in handing Pakistan a total that they can work with. It is a good batting track and the English batsmen will fancy themselves to overhaul the target. Will the hosts race to another victory or will the Pakistani bowlers pull off a magical performance and do a turnaround? Join us after the innings break to find out!

Pakistan have managed to pile up a competitive total of 251 runs after a disastrous start which had them reeling at three for two runs on the board. Babar Azam and Sarfraz Ahmed applied themselves well and stitched together a crucial partnership and bailed Pakistan out of trouble. Ahmed was the star for the Men in Green as he scored a wonderful century! He handled the English seamers with guile and scored against the spinners with authority. He was also involved in a couple of crucial partnerships with Shoaib Malik and Imad Wasim which set the tone for a decent score.

OUT! Amir digs the yorker out and Wasim is charging down from the non-striker's end to get back the strike. Amir is hesitant and Woakes realizes that he can flick off the bails at the non-striker's end which he does and Amir is run out. Pakistan get bowled out for 251!
Wide! Another slower ball but it is misdirected way outside off. Wide signalled by the umpire!
FOUR! Fullish delivery outside off, Amir does enough to lift it over the leaping fielder at mid off and the ball races to the boundary!
Back of the hand slower delivery outside off stump, Amir tries to drill it down the ground but has no clue about where the ball is heading to.
Length ball on middle and leg, Amir has no room to work with and only manages to defend it.
Low full toss, Wasim drives it to deep cover for a single.
Angled into the pads, Amir glances it craftily down to fine leg for a couple!
Shortish ball again, Wasim pulls it down the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Shortish delivery, Wasim tries to pull it but gets a top edge and the ball flies over the keeper and through to the boundary!
Mohammad Amir is the new man in.

OUT! Clever from Wood! Slower ball outside off, Shah tries to club it down the ground but instead gets a top edge and the ball lobs high into the air. Jason Roy at covers is under it and completes an easy catch!
Wide! Wayward ball! Down the leg side, Shah lets it go through. Wide signalled by the umpire.
On a good length around middle and leg, Wasim manages to chip it over mid on for a single.
On a length angled into the pads. Wasim tries to flick it but misses and is rapped high on the pads.
Yasir Shah is the new batsman.

OUT! That's a stunner from Plunkett! Back of a length slower ball outside off stump, Riaz punches it hard to extra cover. Liam Plunkett who is stationed there hurls himself into the air and grabs the ball out of thin air! That was an absolute screamer!

Leg bye! Wasim shuffles across the off stump, Woakes spots him and fires the ball into his front pad. He misses the lap shot and the ball thuds into his pads. The batsmen come through for a single. He seems to be in some sort of discomfort!
Back of the hand slower delivery, Riaz waits for it and works it behind square leg for a single,
FOUR! Intelligent shot! Fraction short of a yorker just outside off, Riaz carves it beautifully through the covers and the ball races to the boundary!
Fullish delivery outside off, Wasim drives it to covers and scampers through for a single. The replays shows that was pretty close, he was just in probably!
Yorker fired in at the stumps, Wasim digs it out just at the nick of time.
Chris Woakes back into the attack!
Fullish delivery, Wasim makes room and drives it down to long on for a single.
Leg bye! Full delivery angling into Riaz who is struck low on the pads. The batsmen come through for a leg bye!
On a length coming in with the angle, Wasim works it down the leg side for a single.
Angled on the pads, Wasim tucks it behind square leg for a couple!
Wasim makes room and Wood spots him. Angles a length delivery from round the wicket and hits him on the thgh pad. Intelligent bowling!
Pacy ball on a good length, comes in a bit. Riaz defends it towards the leg side and comes through for a single.
Mark Wood is back into the attack!
Wahab Riaz is the new batsman.

OUT! And there is a big collision in the deep! Plunkett angles across a length ball around off, Ali tries to swipe it across the line but it catches the top edge and balloons in the air towards deep square leg. Root moves across to his right from deep mid-wicket and Rashid runs across his left from fine leg, both go for it, no calling whatsoever and the former takes the catch before colliding with the latter. Luckily the ball doesn't come off and Ali has to depart. Root seems to have hurt himself but is now on his feet. Limps back to his position. Nothing serious, hopefully.
Back of a length ball angling away from the batsman, Ali has a big wild slash at it but fails to connect.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a run.
2nd ODI fifty for Imad Wasim!

FOUR! Clinical stuff and he reaches a valuable fifty! Plunkett angles across a full length ball outside off, Wasim gets forward and thumps it through the gap between extra cover and mid off for a boundary.
FOUR! Full in length and around middle and off, Wasim gets behind the line and lofts it cleanly over the bowler's head for a boundary down the ground.
SIX! Short and wide outside off, Wasim latches onto it and nails it over backward point for a biggie. Brilliant connection!
Slips in a googly, Ali is watchful in defence.
Wssim flicks it down the leg side for a single.
Flighted delivery, Wasim lifts it over mid off for a couple.
There is an appeal for catch and it has been review upstairs!

Not Out! Tossed up on a length, spinning in. Wasim is cramped for room and inside edges it on a bounce to his pads and the ball is collected by the keeper. The umpire has reviewed it upstairs for a claimed catch and the replays show that it was clearly on the bounce.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wasim punches it off his back foot towards the covers.
Wasim drives it through covers for a single.
Leg bye! Full delivery straying on the pads, Ali is rapped on the pads and the batsmen come through for a single.
Short of a length outside off, Wasim glides it to third man for a single.
Fullish outside off, Wasim drills it to mid off for no run.
Similar delivery wide outside off, Wasim cuts it fiercely to Jason Roy at point who dives to his right ans makes an athletic save!
Back of a length outside off, Wasim has a swing at it but misses.
Flighted on middle, defended off the back foot.
Hasan Ali is the new man in.

OUT! Gone this time! A tempter by Rashid, he tosses it up and lands it full around off, Sarfraz goes down on one knee for the slog sweep but fails to get enough power behind it. He ends up handing a sitter to Hales in the deep mid-wicket region. End of a brilliant knock by Pakistan but they would have loved had he lasted for the full quota of overs.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side for one.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single.

Sharp single! Shortish on off, Wasim goes back to punch but it takes the leading edge and loops in the air. The short third man fielder gets across to his left, picks up the ball but misses his shy at the non-striker's end. A single taken. Direct hit would have been gone.
Full and on off, driven through covers for a single.
Wasim almost drags it back to the stumps as he gets an inside edge and the ball rolls towards the keeper.
Short outside off, Ahmed camps back and plays it through point for a single.

Not out! Fullish delivery directed at the stumps, Ahmed shuffles across and goes for the flick but misses and is rapped on the pads. There is a loud appeal and the umpire rules it out. Ahmed takes a review and the Hawk Eye shows that the ball would have gone down the leg side. That's a very good review and he survives!
Sarfraz is given out to a LBW appeal. He takes the review!
Back of a length ball, Wasim plays it with an angled blade and guides it to third man for a single.
On the pads, Ahmed flicks it down the leg side for a single.
Second ODI Hundred for Sarfraz!
FOUR! On the hips, Ahmed works it down to fine leg and the ball races to the boundary! With that, Ahmed reaches his century. It has been a brilliant innings, perfectly executed!
Liam Plunkett into the attack now!
Googly around middle and off, Imad defends it closer to his front pad.
Gets on the front foot and forces it past the bowler to long on for one.
A touch short on off, Imad stands back and pushes it through cover-point for a run.
Sarfraz goes down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Sliding down the leg side, helped straight to short fine leg. Looked for a run but was sent back.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Adil Rashid into the attack now!
Wasim dabs it to point and runs for a single. The fielder at point has a shy at the stumps and concedes two more runs. That was absolutely unnecessary!
FOUR! That's a brilliant shot! Tossed up, Wasim strides forward and lifts it aerially wide of mid on and the ball races to the fence.
Flighted delivery, Ahmed sweeps it behind square leg for a single. He is inching closer to his century!
On a length this time, Wasim punches it through point for a single.
Floated outside off, Wasim prods forward in defence.
Tossed up on middle, Ahmed nudges it behind square leg for a single.
FOUR! That's a top order shot from Wasim! Short delivery, Wasim stands tall and pulls it confidently through mid-wicket and the ball whistles away to the boundary!
Back of a length around middle, Ahmed tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Similar delivery, Wasim has a wild slash at it and the ball flies through the gully region for a single.
Fullish outside off, Wasim goes for a booming drive but isn't able to connect.
Back of a length outside off, Ahmed plays it through point for a single.
Dug in short wide outside off. Woakes saw him coming and adjusted the length. Ahmed was on the move and in the end sways away.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, spinning in with extra bounce, Ahmed tries to sweep but misses and is hit on the body.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

IN THE AIR... SAFE! Flighted ball on off, Wasim gets down the track to play the inside-out shot over covers but fails to middle it. It comes from the bottom half of the bat and balloons in the air. The long off fielder runs across to his right but the ball falls wide of him. A couple taken.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it off the inside part of the bat to short fine leg. A single taken.
Ahmed dances down the track but decides to defend it.
On the hips, Ahmed works it behind square leg for a single.
Back of a length angled into the body, Ahmed goes for the flick but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
Back of a length wide outside off, Wasim slashes it down to third man for a single.
Similar delivery, a bit closer to off stump, Ahmed drives it through mid off for a single.
Fullish outside off, moving away. Ahmed pushes it to covers again.
Fullish outside off, Ahmed pushes it to the covers nicely.
Wasim dabs it with the turn towards point.
Ahmed plays it with an angled blade to third man for a single.
Loopy delivery, Ahmed kneels down on one knee and sweeps it down to fine leg. The fielder who is stationed there fumbles and allows the batsmen to come through for a couple.
Floated up outside off, Wasim drives it through mid off for a single.
Wasim prods forward in defence to a fullish delivery.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Ahmed works it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length at the stumps, Wasim defends it stoutly.
Back of s length outside off, Ahmed dabs it down to third man for a single.
Around middle and leg, Ahmed flicks it nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
Short of a length outside off, Wasim slashes it away down to third man for a single. That wasn't controlled!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ahmed steers it with an angled blade down to third man for a single.
On a length outside off, Ahmed defends it towards the covers.
Chris Woakes back into the attack in place of Liam Plunkett!
That's Drinks!
On a length outside off, skids through. Ahmed plays it to the point region for a single.
Quicker and flatter on middle, Ahmed nudges it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That was all hand-eye co-ordination! Tossed up, Ahmed dances down the track, is not quite to the pitch of the ball but still lifts it over mid off and the ball races to the fence.
Flighted delivery, Ahmed works it towards mid-wicket.
Wasim plays with the spin and works it behind square leg for a single.
Tossed up, Wasim is compact in his defence.
Helps a length ball to square leg and ends the over with a run.
This time the line from the bowler is too straight and Ahmed easily turns it through square leg for a single.
Too full in length outside off, Sarfraz squeezes it out to point. Tidy bowling.
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, straightening a bit, Sarfraz pushes it with an angled bat to point. "Wait there" is the call from Ahmed.
Sharp delivery, short and around off, Wasim goes back and gently taps it down in the gap on the leg side. They cross for a single.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, nudged through square leg for a single.
Walks down the track and hits it off the inside portion of the bat to long leg. A single taken.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched to wide mid off for a single.
Wasim has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A conventional sweep this time, connects well to send it through square leg for a run.
Oohhh...that got stuck in the grill of the helmet. Sarfraz goes down on one knee for the reverse sweep but misses. It pops out of his forehand and goes into the grill of the helmet. No harm done.
FOUR! Misfield in the deep! Flighted ball on middle, Sarfraz gets down the track and heaves it over wide mid on. Roy in the deep moves across to his right, slides but makes a complete mess.
Back of a length ball on off, darted in this time, Wasim gets behind the line in defense.

Play and a miss! A shortish ball around off, shaping away a bit, Wasim has a gentle push inside the line and misses. The round the wicket angle from the bowler and the ball nipping away, a deadly combo.
Full length ball on off, a bit of in drift, Sarfraz leans across and works it off the inside half of the bat through square leg. A single taken.
Good length ball angling away from the left-hander, Wasim stays back and glides it to third man for a run.
Lands it full and around off, Wasim draws forward and defends.
Full and angling into the batsman, Ahmed flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Wasim defends it off his back foot.
Flighted delivery, draws Wasim forward and he defends it.
Pakistan are in need of yet another partnership here and this is the last recognized pair.

Loopy delivery, Wasim tucks it behind square leg for a single.
Ahmed flicks the flighted delivery through square leg for a single.
Tossed up, Ahmed steps down and pushes it back towards the bowler.
Short ball around leg stump, Wasim ducks with good technique and allows the ball to go through.
Fullish ball outside off, Wasim leans forward and drives it beautifully to extra cover for no run.
On a good length just outside off, Wasim camps back and defends it with authority.
Tight line around off, Wasim lunges forward in defence.
Full ball outside off, Ahmed drives it sweetly through the covers for a single.
Back of a length ball around middle and leg, Ahmed camps back and defends it solidly.
Flighted delivery, Wasim defends it from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up again, Wasim defends it well.
Tossed up, Wasim pushes it to the covers.
Ahmed plays with the spin and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, Ahmed pushes it towards mid on.
On a good length outside off, Ahmed guides it down to third man for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full ball outside off, Ahmed drives it to covers.
On the hips, Wasim flicks it through square leg for a single.
Imad Wasim is the new man in.

OUT! That's a soft dismissal! Shortish delivery outside off, Malik tries to run it down to third man but in the process gets an outside edge to Buttler who pouches it safely. Another good stand but Pakistan needed it to last longer. They're in trouble now!
On a length outside off, Ahmed dabs it down to third man for a single.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. No run.
Floated ball on the pads, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Delicate late cut by Sarfraz, he places it wide of short third man and finally manages to rotate the strike.
Once again Sarfraz finds the mid-wicket fielder as he flicks on the leg side.
Advances down to the pitch of the ball and pushes it gently to mid-wicket.
Flatter full ball on middle, punched to mid-wicket.
Outside off, Malik dabs it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Malik leaves it alone.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a length, swinging in sharply. Malik covers the line well and defends it nicely. Definitely some reverse swing on offer!
Fullish delivery directed at the stumps, Ahmed clips it aerially over mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery, Ahmed lunges forward in defence.
Mark Wood back into the attack!
Ahmed rocks on to the back foot to this tossed up ball and punches it to long on for a single.
Malik flicks it down the leg side for a single.
Malik comes down to a loopy delivery and decides to defend it in the end.
FOUR! Good shot! Flighted outside off, Malik rocks back and cuts it fiercely through point for a boundary!
Malik goes for the cut but gets beaten.

Meanwhile, the 50-run partnership came up between Sarfraz and Malik on the last ball of the 23rd over. Another good stand for Pakistan but they need these two to carry on and lay a strong platform for the death overs hitting.
Malik lunges forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Ahmed plays it through point for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat
Malik lunges forward and pushes it to the covers for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Malik plays it away in front of short third man.
Floated up, Ahmed slaps it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Malik drives it through mid on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the off stump, Malik flicks it with the spin through mid-wicket for a single.
Ahmed flicks it with the spin towards the leg side for a single.
Tossed up, Malik drives it through mid on for a singe.
SIX! That's an amazing shot! Flighted ball outside off, Malik gets his dancing shoes on and lifts it over long off for a beautiful six!
Tossed up, holds its line. Malik gets a thick outside edge towards the off side.
Moeen Ali into the attack now!
5th Fifty up for Sarfaraz Ahmed.
Ahmed pushes it to covers for a single.
FOUR! Flighted outside off, Ahmed dances down the track and lifts it over mid-wicket for a superb boundary. That's 100 up for Pakistan!
Malik places it through point for a single.
Floated outside off, Ahmed sweeps it nicely through square leg for a single.
Flighted ball, a bit slower through the air. Ahmed gets an inside edge to his pads while defending.
Tossed up, Malik drives it through mid on for a single.
Back of a length wide outside off, Ahmed rocks back and cuts it fiercely to point. Roy dives athletically to his left and makes a brilliant save!
On the pads, Malik flicks it away for a single.
Back of a length ball, coming in. Malik camps back and defends it nicely.
Full delivery, a bit wide of the off stump. Ahmed drives it through the covers for a single.
Fullish outside off, Ahmed lunges forward and defends it.
Short delivery, Malik hops back and plays it down the leg side for a single.
Ahmed pushes a loopy delivery to covers this time.
Wrong 'un from Rashid, Malik picks it up well and guides it down to third man nicely. The batsmen come back for three runs. That was a clever shot!
Tossed up and full, Ahmed gets down one own knee and sweeps it behind square leg for a single.
Short and flatter this time, Ahmed pulls it away for a single.
Flighted ball, Malik drives it nicely through mid off for a single.
Loopy ball, Ahmed gets an inside edge which rolls to the leg side.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Short delivery, Ahmed pulls it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, Malik covers the line and flicks it away for a single.
On a length around middle, Ahmed works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish delivery, Ahmed defends it towards point.
Around middle and leg, Ahmed flicks it nicely through mid-wicket for a couple.
Slips in a googly, Ahmed picks it up at the last moment and flicks it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Malik gets a thick inside edge that rolls towards the leg side.
Shorter this time, Ahmed goes back and punches it wide of mid off for a single.
Tossed up and full, Malik drives it to mid off for a single.
Tossed up, Malik punches it to covers.
On a length, skidding in. Ahmed does well to pull it away for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Ahmed pushes it to covers for a single.
On a length outside off, Ahmed defends it towards point.
Back of a length on off stump, Ahmed defends it to covers.
Back of a length outside off, Malik punches it to point for a single.
Leg bye! Straying on the pads, Ahmed tries to flick but misses and the ball rolls to the leg side. The batsmen come through for a leg bye.
Short ball banged into the pitch. Ahmed has all the time in the world to duck under it. That should have been signalled as a wide.
That's Drinks!
Fullish ball outside off, Ahmed punches it off his back foot towards backward point.
Short delivery, Ahmed goes back and pushes it to covers.
Around leg stump, Malik tucks it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up and full, Malik prods forward in defence.
On a length outside off, spinning away. Ahmed pushes it through covers for a single.
Tossed up, Ahmed comes down and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full outside off, Malik pushes it to the covers.
Shoaib Malik is the new batsman in.

OUT! What an unlucky way to get out! Fullish ball around off, Azam goes for the flick but inside edges it to his pads. The ball kisses the pads and rolls to the stumps and the bails fall down. Azam was looking in good touch but he has to depart!
Around middle and leg, Ahmed works it down the leg side for a single.
On a good length outside off, Azam guides it through the slip cordon for a single.
Short delivery outside off stump, Ahmed tries to pull it but checks his shot at the last moment and almost hands it back to the bowler.
Width on offer outside off, guided through point for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

NOT OUT! A touch short and spinning away, Azam cuts it late down to third man and scampers back for the second run. The throw is accurate from the deep, right over the stumps and Buttler is quick in taking the bails off. They appeal, it's referred upstairs but the replays show that Azam is safely in.
Appeal for a run out, referred upstairs...
Loopy ball outside off, Sarfraz comes down the track and pushes it through covers for a single.
Shortish and pulled behind mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and shorter outside off, it's punched through covers for a single.
Angling down leg side, Ahmed works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Good yorker at the stumps, Ahmed is alert to it and digs it out nicely.
Fullish ball outside off, Ahmed dabs it to point. Roy has a shy at the non striker's end and the ball hits the stumps and deflects away. The batsmen come back for a couple!
Back of a length ball outside off, Ahmed steps down a bit and works it through gully for a couple!
There is some issue with the ball and the umpires check it but decide that it is good enough to carry on.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ahmed camps back and dabs it towards point.
50-run stand between Babar Azam and Sarfraz Ahmed!
Fullish ball on the off stump, Ahmed shuffles across and flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple. That was nicely worked!
Liam Plunkett into the attack now!
Short and wide outside off, spinning away, Babar cuts it towards backward point and takes a quick run.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Sarfraz goes deep inside the crease and punches it down the ground. The long off fielder cuts it off and they take two runs.
A flighted full ball on off, Babar forces it through covers for a single.
Comes down the track and defends it close to his front pad.
Shortish on off, hit firmly back to the bowler.
Advances down to the track and drives it with the spin to sweeper cover for a single.
Adil Rashid into the attack now!
Full outside off, Azam lets it go through.
Similar delivery but on the off stump this time, Azam defends it to point.
Back of a length ball, Azam defends it to backward point.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Azam. On a length outside off, Azam waits for it and drives it beautifully through the covers and the ball whistles away to the boundary.
FOUR! That's a delightful shot! Fullish outside off, Azam leans into the drive and times it to perfection through the covers for a gorgeous boundary!
Full outside off, Azam defends it towards backward point.
Ahmed has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Good shot! Short delivery, Ahmed gets into position early and pulls it away confidently through mid-wicket and the ball whistles away to the boundary!
On a length around middle and leg, Ahmed works it down the leg side for a single.
On to the pads, Azam flicks it nicely through mid-wicket and Moeen Ali puts in a good effort and pulls the ball just inside the boundary rope. The batsmen come back for three runs,.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length outside off, Ahmed dabs it to point and comes through for a quick single.
FOUR! Fullish delivery outside off, Azam cover drives it beautifully and the ball pierces through the cover region for a superb boundary!
Full delivery at the stumps, Azam defends it towards covers.
On a length outside off, Ahmed pushes it to point of his back foot and sets off for a run. The point fielder has a shy at the stumps. It would have been pretty close if that had hit.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fullish ball, Ahmed steps down a bit and pushes it to the covers.
Wide! Dug in short. Ahmed ducks under it with good technique. Signalled as a wide by the umpire.
On a good length, coming in sharply. Ahmed tries to flick it but missed and is rapped on the pads. There is a loud appeal from England but in vain! It looked a bit high to the naked eye!
Fullish ball, swinging in. Azam covers the line and inside edges to his pads.
FOUR! That's a great shot! Back of a length wide outside off, Azam punches it through the covers and the ball whistles away to the boundary!
Back of a length ball, Ahmed dabs it through the slip cordon for a single.
Similar delivery, Azam guides it to third man for a single.
Back of a length, Azam defends it.
Four Byes! Short ball on middle and leg, banged in! Ali ducks under it comfortably and the keeper fumbles an easy take and the ball races to the fence. May be there was a bit of wobble on the ball!
Full and moving back into the batsman, Sarfraz pushes it gently to mid on to keep it out safely.
On a length and outside off, tapped in front of the slip cordon.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and angling in, Sarfraz keeps his eyes on the ball and clips it straight to the fielder on the leg side.
Sharp movement back into the batsman, Sarfraz tries to play straight but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Had there been no bat involved, Ahmed would have been a goner.
Almost an action replay of the previous delivery.
Outside off, Azam shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! That's a beautiful shot! Back of a length ball, Azam stays tall and punches it through the covers and the ball races to the fence.
On a length outside off, Ahmed is squared up a bit and plays it with an angled bat through the slip cordon for a single.

FOUR! That's the first boundary of the innings and the Lord's crowd applauds it loudly! Fullish delivery outside off, Ahmed leans into the drive and times it beautifully through covers for a gorgeous boundary!
On a length coming in, Ahmed strides forward and blocks it into the ground.
Back of a length outside off, Azam watches it carefully and lets it go. Good carry on that one!
On a length outside off, Ahmed plays with an angled bat and guides it through the slip cordon for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ahmed leaves it alone.

Fullish delivery directed at the stumps, swinging in. Ahmed loses a bit of balance as he tries to flick it away and is rapped low on the front pad. Loud appeal from England but in vain! It was probably going down leg.
On a length outside off, extra bounce of the pitch. Ahmed fends it away towards the off side.
Sarfaraz Ahmed is the new batsman.

OUT! Pakistan lose their third wicket and are in deep trouble! In the corridor of uncertainty outside off, Ali pokes at it and gets a thick outside edge which flies to the keeper. Buttler makes no mistake and pouches it safely. Woakes is on fire and making the batsmen dance on their tip toes!
Full outside off, Azam chases it and gets beaten. Poor stuff from him!
Good length ball outside off, Azam leaves it alone.
Fullish outside off, Azam drives it confidently towards the covers.
On a length around off, Azam lunges forward in defence.
Babar Azam is the new man in.
OUT! Bowled 'em! That's a ripper! Pacy delivery fired in at the stumps. Khan tries to defend but is beaten for pace and the ball crashes into the stumps. Double blow for Pakistan. England are on top.

Pakistan have won the toss and elected to bat first. They have made three changes to their side. Hafeez, Nawaz and Gul go out and make way for Aslam, Yasir and Hasan Ali in the team. Hasan Ali would be making his debut in international cricket. England remain unchanged.

Hello everyone and a warm welcome on the eve of the 2nd ODI between England vs Pakistan at Lord's. The hosts were dominant in the first game and sailed to victory by 44 runs (D/L Method) in a rain curtailed match. They showed their versatility in every department and were deserved winners. The Men in Green were impressive in patches but failed to put in an all round performance. They would be itching to bounce back and display their heroic style of play. Expect a thrilling encounter at the Mecca of Cricket.
